force_or_question: Who pays for grid expansion and does demand become billed and recovered cash?
control_point: Regulated load, tariff, rider, project, or customer-recovery interface
primary_proof_package: ESA/PPA/tariff/rider filings; billing determinants; approved cost; in-service evidence; collected revenue; recovery schedule
qoe_and_denominator_gate: Receivables and cash collection; capitalized versus expensed project costs; recurring adjustments; debt and rate-base burden; maintenance versus growth capex
promotion_breaker: Evidence stops at load forecast, management commentary, aggregate revenue, or capex plan without category/customer linkage

initial_candidates: Apollo/Athene AP Aristotle; KKR/Global Atlantic Accordia
force_or_question: Which legal entity owns the named asset, what income or cash came back, and did spread survive liability cost?
control_point: Statutory asset row, legal-entity ownership, and liability-funded investment spread
primary_proof_package: Schedule D/BA; investment income; proceeds/disposals; issuer or trustee support; legal-entity cash-flow; liability-cost notes
qoe_and_denominator_gate: Same-CUSIP continuity; realized versus unrealized income; paydown or sale cash; related-party perimeter; cost of funds; parent receipt; dilution and claims
promotion_breaker: Evidence stops at AUM, fair value, or investment income without legal-entity ownership, cash route, or liability-adjusted return

force_or_question: Is borrowing capacity backed by eligible assets that collect or turn into cash?
control_point: Eligible receivable, inventory, fleet, or collateral pool and its borrowing base
primary_proof_package: Borrowing-base certificate; eligibility and advance rates; aging; collateral report; trustee/remittance; facility terms; OCF bridge
qoe_and_denominator_gate: Receivable aging and collections; inventory/payables; reserves; capitalized costs; factoring or securitization; debt service; cash-perimeter and related-party checks
promotion_breaker: Evidence stops at balance-sheet assets, fleet value, or liquidity commentary without eligibility, collection, remittance, or debt-service reconciliation
